name: Snare
description:
Crafting time: Variable.

You prepare a concealed trap that occupies one 5ft x 5ft square for each minute you spend preparing it, up to no more than short range in any dimension. Roll Craft to set the Difficulty.

When a creature enters or begins its turn in the trap area, the trap springs and the creature rolls Dexterity against the Difficulty. On a failure, the creature’s Speed becomes 0. On a pass, the creature's Speed is halved.

Either way, on each of its turns, a trapped creature may spend an action to roll Dexterity against the Difficulty. On a pass, it escapes and its Speed is restored.

Describe your snare.
successes:
✨: The creature must roll Dexterity against the Difficulty and pass one additional time before it can escape.

🌞: The creature is strangled by the snare and cannot breathe while it remains trapped.
